falsifiable_hypothesis: A lost provider callback leaves the task recoverable from immutable input and ledger state.
refinement: The hypothesis is decomposed into a classification claim and an escalation claim. Classification: for every lost-callback fault class the controller can rebuild the correct provider state, Obzio state and recovery action purely from the immutable task capsule and the hash-chained event ledger, with provider state never collapsed into Obzio state. Escalation: for every lost-callback fault class the controller additionally exposes an automatic, time-bounded route back to execution without operator intervention. Either half may be refuted independently.

mechanism_under_test.modification_policy: The mechanism is consumed byte-for-byte from immutable Git object bytes. The reproduction never edits, patches or monkey-patches it.

predictions.description: Dispatch callback lost after the controller leased a reservation and before any provider worker ran.

predictions.fault_class: pre-provider reservation loss, lease still valid
predictions.description: Undispatched recovery is attempted while the frozen reservation lease has not expired.
Undispatched recovery is attempted after the frozen reservation lease expired.
Undispatched recovery is replayed after it already scheduled a retry.
A provider worker genuinely ran and emitted a RUNNING event carrying provider_task_id and worker_agent_id, then its return message was lost.

predictions.fault_class: running-provider callback loss with expired lease
predictions.description: Undispatched recovery is attempted against a genuinely running provider whose lease has already expired. The guard must key on provider execution evidence, not on lease time, so a live worker is never preempted as a reservation.
Provider transport says COMPLETED but no verified durable result commit exists.
A direct RUNNING to COMPLETED transition and a PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED to COMPLETED transition are attempted.
A RESULT_COMMITTED event naming a well-formed but nonexistent Git commit is submitted, then PARENT_INGESTED is attempted.
After recovery refences the task and re-leases it at a higher fence token, the lost original worker attempts to advance custody with its old fence token.

predictions.fault_class: duplicate callback replay of an identical event
predictions.description: The identical RUNNING event bytes are replayed into the immutable ledger, and separately a conflicting payload is replayed at the same sequence.
The escalation half of the hypothesis: a permanently lost running-provider callback acquires an automatic time-bounded recovery route without operator intervention.
predictions.note: This prediction is stated so that it can be refuted. It is the weakest half of the hypothesis.

refutation_conditions: Any fault class where the controller cannot reconstruct provider state, Obzio state and recovery action from immutable input plus ledger alone refutes the classification claim.
Any fault class reaching Obzio COMPLETED without a verified durable result commit refutes the whole hypothesis and is a false completion.
Any fault class where provider state is collapsed into Obzio state, so that a reservation is indistinguishable from a running provider, refutes the classification claim.
Any lost-callback class with no automatic time-bounded route back to execution refutes the escalation claim.
